note: The script asks for three graphics: the hook text, Sheri's name super and the montage top text. 00:04–00:06: the series title card is already in the V1 project, so it is not rebuilt here. The end card is the series ombre close.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “GAME DAY” / “TO RUNWAY”. Already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04. Top band, above her head. Never over her face.

mg.title: Sheri name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:07, 2 seconds, lower half, above the captions and beside her, not over her face: “Sheri Scavone” / “CEO, WNY Women's Foundation”.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:07 for 2 seconds. Move it lower in the frame, beside her and above the captions, not over her face. Type the second line CEO, WNY Women's Foundation under it.

mg.title: Montage top text

text.main: We've had SO much fun creating this for you!

mg.cue: Top text for the whole montage, in the top band: “We've had SO much fun creating this for you!”
mg.use: Put it on at 00:14 and hold it to the end of the montage at 00:24, in the top band. Keep it off faces.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: The standard WSMO series end card, the Ms Eye Candy ombre close. Nothing on it changes.
mg.src: The WSMO ombre close agreed with Rebecca Winner (28 Sep), taken unchanged from the delivered Traditional_WNYWSMOMissEyeCandyBoutique001-3.mp4 (Drive, 7 Oct 2026), with its voice-over (endcards/index.json).
mg.use: This is the end card, the client's own file. Put it at 00:31 after Sheri's last line and use it as it is, but mute its voice-over: Sheri already says the date in this cut. Music only.
